claim: For the Ananichev–Gusev–Volkov automaton \(H_n\) with \(n\ge4\), let \(\lambda_n(s)=\min\{|w|:|Qw|\le n-s\}\) and \(h_n=\lfloor n/2\rfloor+1\). Then \(\lambda_n(1)=1\), with unique shortest word \(b\); for every \(2\le s\le h_n\), \(\lambda_n(s)=3s-3\), with unique shortest word \((bab)^{s-1}\). Whenever \(h_n+1\le n-1\), the linear law fails at the next deficiency: \(\lambda_n(h_n+1)>3h_n\).
integrity: The transition maps, lower-bound argument, witness induction, boundary check, and packaged verifier were checked against the stated \(H_n\) definition. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result determines the initial rank-compression profile through its first saturation point, not the complete profile at larger deficiencies. Finite BFS is corroboration only; the proof is symbolic for all \(n\ge4\). Absolute literature uniqueness cannot be guaranteed beyond the inspected sources and searches.
title: Exact initial rank-compression profile of the automata \(H_n\)
